Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. statement: Let X be an E(2)-local S-module. Suppose the following module maps and homotopies are given. (i) A map w : W → X for which LK(2)w is an equivalence. Put Y = cofib(w), with quotient q : X → Y . 7 (ii) An equivalence κ : LK(1)Umid ≃ − → LK(1)Y , a rational map r : L0Umid → L0Y , and a specified homotopy of Q-module maps between L0Umid −→ L0LK(1)Umid L0κ − − → L0LK(1)Y, L0Umid r − → L0Y −→ L0LK(1)Y. (2.6) (iii) A map b : V → L0X for which t0 : V b − → L0X L0q − − → L0Y −→ cofib(r) (2.7) is an equivalence. Then there is a filtration in E(2)-local S-modules 0 = F0 −→ F1 −→ · · · −→ F8 e − → ≃ X with ordered cofibers W1, W2, U3, U4, V5, V6, V7, V8. The composite F2 = W → F8 e − → X is w.
